tool_args.rationale: The paid observations carry sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation. The quantitative law is therefore scoped unknown rather than suitable for a stationary smooth model confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Stationary smooth relaxation and creep models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot has the high-frequency sign-oscillation signature, so these mechanisms are not supported for reliable forecasting.
The observed signature already triggers scoped abstention under the decision rule.
The auxiliary probe is irrelevant to identifying the forecast law.
